rationale: Independently reviewed the complete catalog API diff against the predecessor commit df1a54da5b18dc8b3ea442691d3694fa2fb67833. The only removed canonical SQL literals are seven negative-only source quarantine, stale-catalog withdrawal and bad-US-EPUB retry operations, now implemented as exact fixed commands in the private legal owner. All twenty-six surviving original SQL sites in the API file retain their exact table, operation, SQL string, function and disposition, and have been re-fingerprinted to this newly reviewed source SHA. The owner verifies independent active regional ingestion leases and run identities before atomic deny-first source, product, offer, edition and rights-grant withdrawal; production owner and positive rights remain locked. Final security-lint corrections only format the catalog API import and owner call; no SQL or business-logic changes. Nine additional ingestion-state SQL sites retired to private owner; reviewed surviving SQL fingerprint re-attestation. Source-only US catalog observation retirement removes three heartbeat/popularity writes without positive rights; all fourteen surviving API sites were re-attested to their exact identities. No production release. Three regional source-state checkpoint statements were subsequently retired behind independently verified private lease and running-ingest guards, preserving eleven unchanged API SQL sites. QA only, production release denied. Two direct US EPUB hydration writes were privately retired with independent R2 EPUB and SHA-256 validation, source rights checks and asset linkage; nine surviving canonical API SQL sites unchanged. Production owner remains locked.
